review.posthog_relevance: Changes Desktop agent workflow for Pi session provisioning, specifically handling the deferral of task-ready notifications to prevent premature UI updates or provisioning errors when a Pi runtime is requested without an existing task ID.

This represents a substantive, bounded capability improvement in the Desktop agent's workflow, preventing premature UI updates or provisioning errors.
